What pass requires: Review type, eligibility, information sources, protocol or registration, and synthesis objective are explicit.
Notes: Do not call a broad evidence map a meta-analysis.

What pass requires: Search, deduplication, duplicate screening, extraction, and author contact are reproducible.
Notes: Show automation use and human verification.

What pass requires: RoB 2, ROBINS-I, QUADAS, PROBAST+AI, or another applicable tool is selected by included design.
Notes: Do not use one quality scale for all designs.

What pass requires: Synthesis model, heterogeneity, influential studies, small-study effects when interpretable, and certainty are addressed.
Notes: Use structured narrative synthesis when pooling is invalid.
